attchmntText: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Jindal Worldwide Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Jindal Worldwide Limited has submitted their response.
voiceSummary: Jindal Worldwide Limited submitted clarifications to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on 16th November 2026 regarding an increase in trading volume. The company stated that all material events and price-sensitive information under SEBI Listing Regulations have been disclosed within the stipulated time. There is no pending information to be disclosed that may impact price movement. The management confirmed that no internal events or information exist that bear on the company's operations or performance. The notable increase in volume is attributed entirely to prevailing market conditions and is market-driven. The company requested the exchange to acknowledge and update its records accordingly. The disclosure was signed by Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Ashish Thaker.
